## File: facebookresearch_fashionplus/postprocess/process_face.py

Prompts

```
['run the face post-processing script to replace faces in generated fashion images with original faces', 'create a function that crops a person bounding box from an image and resizes to 256x256', 'build a function that computes bounding box coordinates from polygon index positions', 'create a function that scales an image to match the width or height of another image', 'review the face replacement logic that overwrites generated head regions based on overlap ratio']
```

Usage

```
{'run_face_postprocess': 'run the face post-processing script to replace faces in generated fashion images with original faces', 'crop_and_resize_person': 'create a function that crops a person bounding box from an image and resizes to 256x256', 'get_polygon_bbox': 'build a function that computes bounding box coordinates from polygon index positions', 'scale_image_dimensions': 'create a function that scales an image to match the width or height of another image', 'review_face_replacement_logic': 'review the face replacement logic that overwrites generated head regions based on overlap ratio'}
```
